query:
INSERT INTO post (thread_id, board_id, author_id, subject, body, created_at)
               SELECT t.id, t.board_id, ?, '', ?, ? FROM thread t
               WHERE t.id = ?
                 AND (? IS NULL
                      OR (SELECT count(*) FROM post WHERE author_id = ? AND created_at >= ?) < ?)
               RETURNING id AS "id!"
